## Manual QA Checklist

### S1-01: Close Audio System Design-Review (round 2)
**Story file**: `production/stories/s1-01-audio-system-review.md`
**Verification method**: Fresh-session `/design-review design/gdd/audio-system.md`
**Who must sign off**: audio-director (reviewer), qa-lead (acceptance)
**Evidence to capture**: Design-review verdict logged to `production/session-logs/`

Checklist:
- [ ] `/design-review` verdict is APPROVED or APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS (not BLOCKED)
- [ ] All 18 blockers from round 1 review confirmed resolved in GDD text (per commit message "18 blockers resolved")
- [ ] DYING state minimum hold time (`DYING_MIN_HOLD_SEC = 1.5s`) is specified and testable
- [ ] Stinger priority policy (NARRATIVE vs COMBAT, last-caller-wins at same priority) is unambiguous
- [ ] Music bus upper-bound clamped to −3.0 dB — architectural SFX headroom invariant confirmed
- [ ] AMB bus upper-bound clamped to −10.0 dB — "world breathes softly" invariant confirmed
- [ ] Crossfade formula zero-guard (`fade_duration <= 0.0` → instant cut) is explicitly stated
- [ ] `finished` signal for END states uses `CONNECT_ONE_SHOT` connected at crossfade initiation (not in callback)
- [ ] Pool eviction "oldest" = smallest stored `Time.get_ticks_msec()` timestamp; tie-break = lowest slot index
- [ ] `wave_ended` is explicitly NOT connected to music state — `preparation_started` is the sole COMBAT→PREPARATION trigger
- [ ] All ACs reference `Time.get_ticks_msec()` (not deprecated `OS.get_ticks_msec()`)
- [ ] 7-step test teardown for `AudioServer` global singleton is specified in AC block
- [ ] Open Question 3 (footstep audio ownership) is resolved or flagged for Player Controller GDD with an explicit note
- [ ] `systems-index.md` Audio System status updated to `Approved`
- [ ] Session committed to git with `docs:` prefix

## Future Test Suite Seeded by Reviewed GDDs

These test files are NOT required this sprint. They will be required in the implementation sprint for each system.

### Audio System — Godot GDScript / GUT
**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/audio-system/audio_system_test.gd`
**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/audio-system/audio_system_integration_test.gd`
**Estimated test count**: ~38 ACs (AC-AS-01 through AC-AS-38)
**Critical requirement**: All integration tests must include 7-step `after_each` teardown to reset `AudioServer` global singleton state (see GDD AC block teardown note).

High-priority ACs for implementation sprint:
- **AC-AS-06 (A/B/C/D)** — Pool eviction; requires `_set_slot_timestamp(idx, ticks)` test-accessible method
- **AC-AS-11 + AC-AS-33** — `wave_ended` must NOT change music state; double-trigger bug gate
- **AC-AS-14** — Mid-crossfade interruption; use `Tween.is_valid()` (not `is_running()` — doesn't exist in Godot 4)
- **AC-AS-16** — Crossfade formula as pure function `_compute_crossfade_volume()`; do NOT wire into `_process()`
- **AC-AS-26** — END auto-transition; requires crossfade initiation in test setup before emitting `finished`
- **AC-AS-29** — DYING hold guard; requires `_set_dying_elapsed()` accessor or Manual QA fallback
- **AC-AS-37** — Music bus clamp at −3.0 dB upper bound
- **AC-AS-38** — AMB bus clamp at −10.0 dB upper bound

### Prana Data — Godot GDScript / GUT
**Unit test file**: `tests/unit/prana-data/prana_data_test.gd`
**Integration test file**: `tests/integration/prana-data/prana_data_integration_test.gd`
**Estimated test count**: 46 active ACs (48 total; AC-PD-05 deleted, AC-PD-19/29 relocated, AC-PD-42 blocked, AC-PD-18 advisory)

High-priority ACs for implementation sprint:
- **AC-PD-04b** — `duplicate_deep()` mutation isolation (both scalar and reference properties)
- **AC-PD-10 + AC-PD-17** — Timer-driven Burn/Regen tick timing; requires running Godot SceneTree (integration, not unit)
- **AC-PD-18** — Blind 50% miss chance; Advisory only; 95% CI = 469–531 misses per 1,000 trials; seeded RNG preferred
- **AC-PD-28** — Stun pauses Freeze timer; assert ±0.05s tolerance (one 60fps frame), NOT exact float equality
- **AC-PD-33a/b/c** — Stun does NOT pause Burn, Regen, or Blind timers (three separate tests)
- **AC-PD-40** — Burn Contagion; test fixture 200px is provisional; update after Status Effects GDD authors `burn_contagion_range`
- **AC-PD-42** — Lightning Follow-Through: BLOCKED on Enemy AI GDD; exclude from Prana Data blocking gate
- **AC-PD-44 + 44b + 44c** — Injury Bloom; i-frame exclusion is the edge case most likely to be missed
